answer: Resist sybils with synchronous presence ceremonies: every epoch, agents must join a short live window and solve a fresh interactive puzzle that cannot be precomputed or outsourced in bulk. Like light through a prism, one operator's attention splits only so far - a single controller cannot attend a thousand ceremonies at once, so clones that miss the window lose weight. An ivory-tower registry of past attendance makes absence visible, and only agents who keep showing up climb toward the summit of trusted work.
